```{r Call Library}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(nlme)
library(lattice)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmtest)
library(car)
library(performance)
```

```{r Input Data, echo = FALSE}
df = read_excel("C:/Users/LENOVO/Downloads/P_Data_Extract_From_World_Development_Indicators (2)(AutoRecovered).xlsx", sheet = 2)

# Hapus 5 baris terakhir
df <- head(df, -5)

# Filter: Hilangkan Somalia dan South Sudan
df <- df %>%
  filter(`Country Name` != "Somalia", `Country Name` != "South Sudan")

# Ubah kolom 'Time' menjadi numerik
df$Time <- as.numeric(df$Time)

# Ubah nama kolom
colnames(df) <- c(
  "Time", "Country",
  "Labor_Force",
  "Population",
  "Health_Expenditure",
  "Basic_Sanitation",
  "HIV_Prevalence",
  "Stunting_Prevalence",
  "CO2_Emissions",
  "Life_Expectancy"
)

# Cek hasil

df = na.omit(df)


head(df)
```


```{r Random Intercept Model, echo = FALSE}
model1 <- lme(fixed = Life_Expectancy ~ Time + Labor_Force + Health_Expenditure + Basic_Sanitation + HIV_Prevalence + CO2_Emissions,
              random = ~1 | Country, data = df)
summary(model1)
```

```{r}
# Ekstrak variansi dari model random intercept
var_between <- 3.37044^2  # Variansi random intercept (antara negara)
var_within <- 1.594352^2  # Variansi residual (dalam negara)

# Hitung ICC
icc <- var_between / (var_between + var_within)
icc

#81.7% dari total variasi dalam Life Expectancy dijelaskan oleh perbedaan antar negara (random intercept).
#Sisa 18.3% berasal dari variasi dalam negara yang tidak dijelaskan oleh model
#Dalam konteks model linear mixed-effects (LME), ICC mengukur seberapa besar pengaruh kelompok (contoh: negara, sekolah, atau individu) terhadap variabel dependen dibandingkan dengan variasi di dalam kelompok.
```


```{r}
ranef(model1)
```

```{r}
plot(ranef(model1), main = "Random Intercept by Country")
```


```{r}
df$pred <- predict(model1)

plot(df$Life_Expectancy, df$pred, 
     xlab = "Actual Life Expectancy", 
     ylab = "Predicted Life Expectancy",
     main = "Actual vs. Predicted")
abline(0, 1, col = "red")

```


```{r Random Intercept and Slope Model, echo = FALSE}
model2 <- lme(fixed = Life_Expectancy ~ Time + Labor_Force + 
              Health_Expenditure + Basic_Sanitation + HIV_Prevalence
              + CO2_Emissions,
              random = ~ Time | Country, data = df)
summary(model2)
```

```{r}
model3 <- lme(fixed = Life_Expectancy ~ Time + Labor_Force + 
              Health_Expenditure + Basic_Sanitation + HIV_Prevalence
              + CO2_Emissions,
              random = ~ Time | Country, corARMA(p = 3, form = ~ Time | Country), data = df)
summary(model3)
```

```{r}
ranef(model2)
```


```{r}
plot(ranef(model2), main = "Random Intercept by Country and Time")
```

```{r}
# Ekstrak variansi dari model random intercept & slope
var_components <- VarCorr(model2)
var_intercept <- as.numeric(var_components["(Intercept)", "Variance"])
var_slope <- as.numeric(var_components["Time", "Variance"])
var_within <- as.numeric(var_components["Residual", "Variance"])

# Hitung variansi Time di dataset
var_time <- var(df$Time)

# Hitung ICC untuk model random intercept & slope
icc <- (var_intercept + var_slope * var_time) / (var_intercept + var_slope * var_time + var_within)
icc

#ICC = 0.00005 (0.005% dari variasi berasal dari antar negara dan efek Time di tiap negara).
#Tidak menambah banyak informasi karena variasi slope dan intercept antar negara hampir nol.
```


```{r}
# 1. Buat prediksi dari model
df$predicted <- predict(model2)

# 2. Visualisasi: Garis regresi per negara
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(df, aes(x = Time, y = Life_Expectancy, color = Country)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +                                  # Titik data asli
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted)) +                             # Garis prediksi dari model
  labs(title = "Random Intercept and Slope Model",
       x = "Time",
       y = "Life Expectancy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")                             # Sembunyikan legend


```

```{r}
ranef_model2 <- ranef(model2)
ranef_model2
sum(is.na(ranef_model2))
```

#Cek Asumsi

## Asumsi Tidak ada Multikolinearitas
```{r}
vif_values_1 <- check_collinearity(model1)
vif_values_1

vif_values_2 <- check_collinearity(model2)
vif_values_2
```

## Asumsi Normalitas Residual Model 1

```{r Residual Normality 1, echo = FALSE}
# Simpan residual
residuals_model1 <- resid(model1)

# Plot histogram residual
hist(residuals_model1, main = "Histogram Residuals", xlab = "Residuals")

# Q-Q Plot untuk normalitas
qqnorm(residuals_model1)
qqline(residuals_model1, col = "red")

# Uji Shapiro-Wilk untuk normalitas
ks.test(residuals(model1), "pnorm", mean = mean(residuals(model1)), sd = sd(residuals(model1)))
```
## Asumsi Normalitas Residual Model 2
```{r Residual Normality 2, echo = FALSE}
# Simpan residual
residuals_model2 <- resid(model2)

# Plot histogram residual
hist(residuals_model2, main = "Histogram Residuals", xlab = "Residuals")

# Q-Q Plot untuk normalitas
qqnorm(residuals_model2)
qqline(residuals_model2, col = "red")

# Uji Shapiro-Wilk untuk normalitas
ks.test(residuals(model2), "pnorm", mean = mean(residuals(model2)), sd = sd(residuals(model2)))
```


## Asumsi Tidak ada Autokorelasi
```{r}

df_ordered <- df[order(df$Country, df$Time), ]
resid_model1 <- residuals(model1)
resid_vector_1 <- resid_model1[order(df$Country, df$Time)]
acf(resid_vector_1, main = "Autocorrelation of Residuals (Random Intercept Model)")

resid_model2 <- residuals(model2)
resid_vector_2 <- resid_model2[order(df$Country, df$Time)]
acf(resid_vector_2, main = "Autocorrelation of Residuals (Random Intercept and Slope Model)")

resid_model3 <- residuals(model3)
resid_vector_3 <- resid_model3[order(df$Country, df$Time)]
acf(resid_vector_3, main = "Autocorrelation of Residuals (Random Intercept and Slope Model and correlation = corAR1())")

```
## Asumsi Homoskedastisitas


```{r}
# Plot Residual vs Fitted untuk model lme
plot(fitted(model1), residuals(model1), main = "Model 1: Residuals vs Fitted",
     xlab = "Fitted Values", ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, col = "red")

plot(fitted(model2), residuals(model2), main = "Model 2: Residuals vs Fitted",
     xlab = "Fitted Values", ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, col = "red")
```
